mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, exceeding a 0.5% month-over-month decline, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies struggle with input constraints and rising costs.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a triggered INDPRO decline signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate, especially if the 3-month change exceeds 0.3 percentage points, signals a weakening labor market that will drag on consumer spending and negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence rises by > 2 points in the University of Michigan survey during the signal period, contradicting the negative labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the higher cost of borrowing weighs on investment and consumption.
failure_condition: Real GDP growth accelerates by > 1% (annualized) during the signal period, indicating that the economy is resistant to the higher interest rates.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost economic activity and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the construction sector leads the economy higher.
failure_condition: The 10-year Treasury yield rises by > 50 basis points during the signal period, indicating that higher borrowing costs will undermine the housing recovery.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth slows by > 100k jobs/mo for 2mo
failure_condition: Initial jobless claims fall by > 10% during the signal period, contradicting the negative labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures rise by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals a surge in consumer demand that will boost corporate revenues and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The ISM manufacturing PMI falls below 50 during the signal period, indicating that the demand surge is not supported by the broader economy.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3%, it signals rising price pressures that will erode consumer purchasing power and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed is forced to tighten monetary policy.
failure_condition: The Fed cuts interest rates by > 25 basis points during the signal period, indicating that it is prioritizing growth over inflation fighting.
